description: ADJ-LADDER rung 45 — weight-and-time-normalised drug elimination rate from four stated quantities (a NEW panel: pharmacokinetic elimination rate). From an administered and a residual dose plus the body weight and elapsed time compute the elimination rate ((administered_dose-residual_dose)/(body_weight*elapsed_time)), the eliminated amount (administered_dose-residual_dose), or the weight*time product (body_weight*elapsed_time). Each item is a compute_dimensioned program (observe the four quantities, let answer = formula); the ADJ engine carries the arithmetic — a NEW shape, DIFFERENCE-OVER-PRODUCT (a-b)/(c*d), the first quotient on the ladder to divide a parenthesised difference by a parenthesised product (distinct from rung-41 difference-over-sum (a-b)/(a+b), rung-42 sum-over-difference (a+b)/(c-d), and rung-44 product-over-sum (a*b)/(c+d)) — and the harness matches the scalar to the printed options. Contamination-safe: every index is built only from the four observed quantities via -, * and / — no constant leaks, and neither the eliminated amount, the weight*time product, nor any rate ever appears as a literal (each is computed) — and the observed quantities carry digit-free identifiers so no numeral hides inside a variable name. The five options are a family over the same four quantities, so the distractors are exactly the slips students make: normalising by the body weight alone (dropping the elapsed time), and ADDING the weight and time instead of multiplying them. The core confusion tested is dividing the eliminated amount by the weight-times-time product.

items.stem: A 100 mg dose is given to a 4 kg patient; after 2 h, 20 mg remains. What is the weight-and-time-normalised elimination rate (amount eliminated over weight times time)?
items.program:
observe administered_dose(100)
observe residual_dose(20)
observe body_weight(4)
observe elapsed_time(2)
let answer = (administered_dose - residual_dose) / (body_weight * elapsed_time)
? answer

items.stem: A 100 mg dose is given to a 4 kg patient; after 2 h, 20 mg remains. What is the the amount of drug eliminated (administered minus residual)?
items.program:
observe administered_dose(100)
observe residual_dose(20)
observe body_weight(4)
observe elapsed_time(2)
let answer = administered_dose - residual_dose
? answer

items.stem: A 100 mg dose is given to a 4 kg patient; after 2 h, 20 mg remains. What is the the weight-times-time product (the normalising denominator)?
items.program:
observe administered_dose(100)
observe residual_dose(20)
observe body_weight(4)
observe elapsed_time(2)
let answer = body_weight * elapsed_time
? answer
